meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在你说界面做完了时会自己截图取证:对网页、终端界面和分页文档做视觉对比,跑脚本出差异数据,再派两个只读审查员并行复核,最后给出 PASS/REVISE/FAIL 结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面、准备宣布完成时接管;也用于你问某个页面、组件或 TUI 是否看起来对劲时。没有渲染输出时跳过。

say.text: 帮我做视觉 QA:截图对比这个页面和设计稿
say.note: 会跑 image-diff 并派两个只读审查员

say.text: 这个终端 TUI 有没有文字溢出或边框错位?
say.note: 跑 tui-check 检查宽度与边框

say.text: 这 40 页 PDF 每页都截图对比一下
say.note: 分页文档逐页取证,不抽样

howto.what_en: After install, Claude screenshots the UI whenever you build or change one: it diffs web, terminal, and paginated surfaces, runs script evidence, dispatches two read-only reviewers in parallel, and returns a PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, before calling it done, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Do visual QA: diff this page against the mock
say_en.note: Runs image-diff plus two read-only reviewers

say_en.text: Does this TUI overflow or misalign borders?
say_en.note: Runs tui-check on width and borders

say_en.text: Screenshot and compare every page of this 40-page PDF
